nodes.description: address private owner; privileged account used for all authorization checks
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address counter of sale transfers
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist bypassing the sale condition
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer amount enforced by condition()
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer amount enforced by condition()
uint256 private _saleNum; maximum number of sale transfers per address
address tradeAddress; address exempted from the sale condition
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances updated with unchecked arithmetic
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; approvals updated with unchecked arithmetic
uint public totalSupply; set in the constructor with an unchecked multiplication
uint constant public decimals = 18; scaling factor used in init() and the constructor
string public name; ERC20 metadata assigned in the constructor
string public symbol; ERC20 metadata assigned in the constructor
address constant UNI = 0x7a250d...; router address exempted in ensure()
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from
ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view; whitelist check plus condition() gating
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable; performs unchecked balance/allowance updates and ensure()
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable; owner-only delegatecall to a caller-supplied target
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only configuration of sale limits
batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only loop crediting balances
setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only update of the exempt trade address
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure; deterministic Uniswap pair address computation
constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable; mints supply to msg.sender and sets owner
msg.sender; attacker-controlled caller used for authorization, balances and approvals
